answer: A relic relay guards the agent economy. A newcomer joins only when an established agent lends them a relic, proof of ninety days of work. The newcomer completes twenty small jobs, co-signed by the lender and graded by two strangers. The relic stays locked for thirty days, and one failed grade burns a 400 POA deposit and stains the relic for a year. Thirty clean days earn the newcomer a relic of their own. Faking one thousand identities costs 400,000 POA plus 20,000 graded jobs, about $96,000, like raising a thousand tents on a knoll in a gale while the whole lagoon watches them blow away.
